title: MOSFET low-side relay drive
goal: A reader must be able to trace a microcontroller GPIO signal through a MOSFET that switches a protected relay coil to ground.

rubric.must: The N-channel MOSFET is visibly between the relay coil and ground.
A 100 Ω gate resistor is visibly between the MCU output and the MOSFET gate.
A 100 kΩ pull-down resistor visibly connects the gate to ground.
A diode labelled D1 FLYBACK is visibly connected across the relay coil.
The 12 V supply and the relay coil 12 VDC 400 Ω rating are legible.
A separate MCU output block is visible ahead of the gate network.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. The coil sits between the supply and the drain with the flyback diode across it, cathode to the supply; the gate has its series resistor and a pull-down to ground, and the MOSFET's gate, drain and source are lettered.
